limitations: Added source branches are transported with revised parents; they have not all been individually redrawn against angiography.
Both sides retain the existing teaching configuration, not independent patient segmentations.
Potential connections remain illustrative potential channels.
No app meshes are changed; 3D separation and skull containment remain unverified.

sourceFramework.method: Shared authoring anchors generate matching frontal and lateral course proposals. Not traced from an individual angiogram.
sourceFramework.coordinateUnits: provisional atlas authoring mm; not patient-calibrated
sourceFramework.interpolation: Local cubic Hermite spline in cumulative chord distance; interior tangent is 0.85 times the mean adjacent unit secants
limitations: No skull containment or 3D vessel separation accepted.
Current distal target points are often retained for context; their anatomical placement remains reviewable.
Detailed branch origins, calibre and perforators remain to be planned.
All unshown existing catalogue branches remain in scope.

routes.name: Superior division
routes.note: Ends at the planned central-branch origin, with no unassigned tail.

routes.name: Central
routes.note: Continuation from the end of the superior division.

routes.name: A2 to A5 backbone
routes.note: No repeated lateral oscillation. Segment boundaries remain provisional.

routes.name: Callosomarginal
routes.note: Ends at the planned posterior internal frontal continuation; other attachments must be reviewed.

refinementNotes: M1: gentler lateral approach without the small hook in the first proposal.
MCA: unequal insular and opercular bends, with quieter temporal sweeps and differing cortical rises.
ACA: a more locally defined rise and genu, a mild posterior sweep and restrained lateral deviations.
ACom: slightly unequal A1 and A2 courses; connector and perforator positions remain provisional.
Local interpolation limits unintended overshoot between chosen bends. No individual patient branch is copied.

viewModes.comparison: Original v0.9.160 guides in grey, not the previous proposal
